subject: Recomendations for parcial tagging of photos

messages.author: e038ae7cbb344cd7
messages.subject: Recomendations for parcial tagging of photos
parts:
Hi, 

I am running a large scale camera trapping survey with 180 sites (individual camera trap folders).

We have half of the data back (pictures) and would like to start tagging in digikam.

I have created the station folders (all 180 sites).    Following that I have renamed photos in 90 sites and they have been uploaded to the "outdir" folder.  

I would like to start tagging those 90 sites.

So my question is if it is possible to then add the remainin 90 sites to the outdir? 

Is is possible that the specified inDir with the second set of 90 sites is loaded to the outdir that contains first set of 90 sites.  And using a station folder file that contains the entire 180 sites?

Or do I have to do separate projects and then merge data sets?

Any recomendations are welcomed!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Recomendations for parcial tagging of photos
parts:
Hi, 
yes, you can start tagging images and later rerun imageRename to add the next batch of images to outDir
The function will not overwrite existing images in outDir. Just make sure you don't rename any renamed images after running imageRename, otherwise the function will copy these images and there will be duplicates.
You can also run imageRename with a separate outDir and then combine the images later (by copying the station directories into the same directory). 
Cheers,
Jürgen
